But the tables are sized `SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` = 26 elements (indices 0-25). So `builtInTypeId == 26` would be OOB.

The check allows `builtInTypeId <= 26`, so `builtInTypeId == 26` passes the check but is OOB (index 26 is out of bounds for a 26-element array).

2. The variant must be an array type (so it goes to `ReadVariantArrayBuiltInType`)
